courses.summary: Horizon 公開架構整合露天採礦、瀝青萃取與現場升級；本課分析原料變動在三階段之間的傳遞。本課依序分析採礦供料的有效產能、萃取成分帳、升級供氫界線、回收水與細粒累積、三階段質量調和，每項都包含可重算模型、證據規劃、故障辨析與驗收成果。數字全部是教學假設；不宣稱本案例採用這些設備參數。
courses.summaryEn: Horizon integrates surface mining, bitumen extraction and onsite upgrading; this case tracks feed variation across those stages. The course analyses effective mining-feed capacity, extraction-component account, hydrogen boundary for upgrading, recycle water and fine-solid accumulation, mass reconciliation across three stages, with recalculable models, evidence plans, fault discrimination and acceptance artifacts. All numbers are teaching assumptions; no plant-specific parameter is asserted.
